caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest of drawers with four drawers arranged vertically. The chest features a serpentine or undulating front profile, where each drawer face curves outward in the center and recedes at the sides. The drawer faces are medium brown with a lighter, wood grain pattern framed by a golden-yellow border, and each drawer has two oval brass handles with a decorative backing plate. The main structure of the chest, including the top, sides, and legs, is a darker brown wood. The legs are slender and gently curve outward at the front corners, and the bottom edge of the chest is scalloped to match the shape of the drawers. The chest is set against a plain, uncolored background with a single-lined rectangular border around it.
title: Chest of Drawers
